messages:
Carla (AE): We received an RFP from Tidewell Health. They want a completed capability matrix, the security questionnaire answers, a short POC runbook, and a pricing appendix (reserved vs hosted) including an HSM add-on. Deadline = 72 hours. Starter sheet uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/tidewell_rfp_seed.xlsx

Sam R. - Solutions: Quick scan 4 notes: sustain ~5k embeddings qps, BYOK/HSM, and model pinning for the POC. Two recommended paths: Dedicated reserved pool (SLA scoping possible) or Hosted-burst with autoscale + fallback model. I'll add measured qps for fp16 and 8-bit quant options.

Ravi (Infra): Infra note: for a sustained 5k qps baseline we recommend 7 x A100-80GB with NVLink, dynamic batching up to 512, KV cache enabled, and private peering. If they opt for Private deployment in their VPC, HSM integration testing adds ~48-72 hours. I'll draft the peering and firewall snippet.

Marta (Security): Reviewed the questionnaire. Top items to address: HSM attestation and key custody proof, logging retention and SIEM export, and incident notification SLA (<1hr requestlegal signoff). We support cross-account KMS and an HSM gateway for key-wrap. I'll attach SOC2 and KMS guide.

Sam R. - Solutions: I'll populate the capability matrix and POC ops checklist. Bench example: `ri bench --model redwood-embed-v2 --concurrency 130 --batch-max 512 --duration 600`. POC KPIs: sustained qps, p99 latency, error rate, output validation. Pricing appendix will include 1h / 8h / 24h examples and an HSM validation fee line.

Ravi (Infra): Network snippet draft: allow outbound 443 and 8443, exchange peering CIDRs, open egress for telemetry; expected egress approx ~2TB for 24h at target qps. For SIEM: we can stream logs to customer S3 or push to their syslog endpoint (optional).

Marta (Security): Uploads: SOC2: https://redwood.app/security/soc2_2025.pdf ; KMS guide: https://redwood.app/docs/kms-hsm-integration. Flagging HSM attestation item to Legal now.

deploy-bot: Sandbox job queued: ci/tidewell-poc-sbox (eta 1769011500). :rocket:

Carla (AE): Action items: Sam  fill matrix + ops checklist + pricing (due tomorrow EOD). Ravi  infra + peering snippet + HSM test steps (due tomorrow EOD). Marta  security questionnaire + attachments (due in 2 business days). I'll assemble and send.

Sam R. - Solutions: Will include a canary fallback plan (lower-capacity model) and traffic-shaping guidance. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Infra): Adding HSM test checklist and expected timeline for on-prem validation.

Marta (Security): Also include audit trail options (tamper-evident logs) and SIEM export details in the matrix.

Carla (AE): Thanks everyone. If Legal needs to propose addendum language for HSM attestation, ping me and I'll loop them in. Keep updates in-thread.
